text: Mira Sen is a fictional Computer Science student at Northbridge Institute. She builds software and applied-AI projects.
Mira is enrolled in a Computer Science degree from August 2024 to July 2028, with graduation expected in July 2028.

Library Compass passed 18 of 20 relevance checks on a small development set. This is not a production accuracy estimate; two ambiguous queries failed.
Mira coordinated weekly meetings and mission task allocation in a student engineering club, and guided juniors using demonstrations. This was not paid employment.
